summary: Successfully completed comprehensive backend testing of LockBay Telegram bot fee calculation bug fixes. Verified two critical bug fixes: (1) Minimum escrow fee of $10 now correctly applies at exactly $100 threshold (fixed < to <=), and (2) When buyer chooses 'split' fee and cancels, buyer now pays FULL platform fee on cancellation as intended. All fee calculation scenarios tested including threshold edge cases, fee splitting, and cancellation refund calculations. Backend is fully operational and bug fixes are working correctly.
